summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a routine payment notice for its Fixed Rate Series XVIII Notes. The notice announces the fifth interest installment payment of USD 743,153.68 on August 28, 2026, covering the period February 28, 2026 to August 28, 2026, on a principal amount of USD 21,408,926 at a 7.00% annual rate. Payment agent is Caja de Valores S.A. This is a routine debt service disclosure with no special-situation elements.
